cause: The contribution-to-redistribution result_announce fence passed and both cxi endpoints entered redistribution. A rank that had assembled all of its own result shards then advanced to the next generation while its peer still needed late fetch service. The peer rejected the next-generation contribution control frame during redistribution and the advanced rank rejected the reciprocal late fetch in its contribution stage. The native gate lacked a symmetric fenced end-of-generation exchange that continued serving peer fetches until both assemblers were complete.
correction: After local assembly completes, send a strict authenticated goodbye for the frozen generation and continue servicing fetch/result traffic until the peer's matching goodbye is received. Validate run, fence, generation, attempt, owner epoch, layout, base, no-body bounds, and a live deadline before accepting the transition; only then release and advance.
